description: Match an XML/XSD or invoice error code or message to an existing guide and explanation. Returns a general guide when no exact match exists.

code.description: Validation error code to explain, for example BR-DE-15 or cvc-enumeration-valid. Supply code, message, or both.

message.description: Validation error message to match against existing guides (at most 2,000 characters). Supply message, code, or both; omit confidential document values.

standard.description: Explicit existing fixed rule package. Factur-X accepts extracted XML only; KSeF is FA(3) XSD only.

name: explain_validation_error
title: Explain a validation error
